changes: Stable ascending integer level grouping and child-to-parent-level grouping use NumPy stable sort and split.
Original prepend adjacency order is reconstructed exactly; root ownership and real cut representatives use existing parent-before-child depth levels.
Episode forest uses int32 adjacency and owner arrays directly and does not allocate an unused int64 cut vector.
Per-hold cut class IDs and directional pair cells preserve first occurrence with exact injective integer keys.
Episode consecutive-hold validation uses a stable integer grouping; original episode/member order remains unchanged.
Fingerprints retain original dtype/shape/raw-byte hashes and stream byte hashing in bounded chunks.
limitations: Tiny parity does not prove full-parent runtime or peak memory; no speedup factor is claimed.
Original per-hold layout, root classification, clade mask construction and episode membership loops remain Python.
Whole-array stable sorting has finite but substantial scratch; no full-parent resource qualification has been performed.
No live training integration or source pin/admission change has been made.
The all20 compact cache is not currently admissible against the current v3 workflow projection; no disk cache population is authorized by this record.

persistence.bounded_reuse: No global cache or retained parent pool. Caller owns the returned tensors and must release previous parent objects before admitting another read; read_peak_upper_bound_bytes must fit max_expanded_bytes.
persistence.completeness: Every original dataclass tensor and scalar is retained or reconstructed exactly; no hold, leaf, episode, cut tensor, site or focal-count truncation.
persistence.external_genotype: Existing observed genotype NPY may be referenced only after SHA and every-value equality checks; no copied genotype corpus is required.
persistence.integer_index_recipe: Store exact uint16 height/depth labels and rebuild upward_levels, upward_children, upward_parent_rank and downward_levels in original order.
persistence.lossless_storage: Integer tensors/counts use smaller widths only after exact round-trip validation; exact aligned/sham support equality is required before shared storage.
persistence.mutation_contract: Returned observations are immutable inputs; copy-on-write protects cache files from tensor writes.
persistence.once_only: Fresh nonexistent directory required; all complete-parent size planning and caller cap admission precede mkdir. Existing cache directory is never overwritten.
persistence.read_peak_formula: original expanded tensor bytes + 256 * packed nodes + 64MiB
persistence.read_reuse: Authenticate complete receipt/array hashes, mmap arrays copy-on-write and expand original dtypes in bounded chunks; reconstruct original dataclass types and source/tensor stamps.

storage.reservation_note: Current projection charges retained scopes plus finite active/new reservations; active reservation charges may later settle to smaller retained values. No permanent occupancy or available-space claim.

unchanged_float_math: Original observed branch support kernels and aligned/sham values are retained.
Original clade masks, unary representative choice, episode IDs/member order and FP32 leave-one-out span reductions are retained.
Original cut conditional-information float summation is retained.
No model, objective, schedule, split, barrier, truth or sample subset change.
